# AACT (American Association of Chemistry Teachers)

> AACT provides comprehensive K-12 and AP Chemistry education resources, professional development, and a community platform for chemistry teachers.

AACT, affiliated with the American Chemical Society, offers classroom resources including lesson plans, multimedia, and collections curated from ACS and National Historic Chemical Landmarks. The site serves as a hub for chemistry educators seeking innovative teaching strategies, professional development opportunities, and peer collaboration through webinars, conferences, and mentorship programs.

## Key Topics

- AP Chemistry
- K-12 Chemistry Education
- Classroom Resources
- Professional Development
- Lesson Plans

## Core Resources

- [AACT Homepage](https://teachchemistry.org): AACT homepage offering Chemistry Solutions for K-12 and AP Chemistry education
- [Classroom Resources Hub](https://teachchemistry.org/classroom-resources): Main hub for AACT classroom resources including lesson plans, labs, and multimedia
- [Chemistry Topics Directory](https://teachchemistry.org/classroom-resources/topics): Chemistry topics directory covering acids-bases, atomic structure, electrochemistry
- [AP Chemistry Units](https://teachchemistry.org/classroom-resources/ap-units): AP Chemistry units and curriculum resources organized by AP standards

## Multimedia & Collections

- [Multimedia Resources](https://teachchemistry.org/classroom-resources/multimedia): Interactive multimedia resources including videos, games, and simulations for chemistry
- [Curated Collections](https://teachchemistry.org/classroom-resources/collections): Curated K-12 chemistry collections from ACS and National Historic Chemical Landmarks

## Professional Development

- [Professional Development Hub](https://teachchemistry.org/professional-development): Professional development hub with webinars, training, and CEU opportunities for teachers
- [Webinars](https://teachchemistry.org/professional-development/webinars): Free webinars on chemistry teaching, AI in classroom, and data analysis with certificates
- [Teacher Learning Opportunities](https://teachchemistry.org/professional-development/teacher-learning): Teacher learning opportunities including conferences, grants, workshops, and webinars
- [Science Coaches Program](https://teachchemistry.org/professional-development/science-coaches): Science Coaches Program with mentor matching for K-12 chemistry teachers in US territories

## Chemistry Solutions Periodical

- [Chemistry Solutions Main](https://teachchemistry.org/periodical): Chemistry Solutions periodical with innovative teaching articles and classroom resources
- [Article Archive](https://teachchemistry.org/periodical/articles): Article archive searchable by AP Chemistry, NGSS, and instructional strategies
- [About Chemistry Solutions](https://teachchemistry.org/periodical/about): About Chemistry Solutions periodical with membership benefits and submission guidelines
- [Submit an Article](https://teachchemistry.org/periodical/submit-an-article): Article submission guidelines and peer review process for Chemistry Solutions

## ChemMatters

- [ChemMatters Archive](https://teachchemistry.org/chemmatters): ChemMatters article archive with teacher guides for high school chemistry education

## Community & Engagement

- [Get Involved](https://teachchemistry.org/get-involved): Membership, volunteer, and community contribution opportunities with AACT

## Optional

- [March 2026 Issue](https://teachchemistry.org/periodical/issues/march-2026): March 2026 Chemistry Solutions issue featuring 3D printing and gas laws activities
